title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
description: A whole bird poached below a simmer, shocked in ice water, and served at room temperature over rice cooked in its own broth and fat. Two sauces on the side, both mandatory.
notes: Four components, and the rice is the one people underestimate. It is not a side — it carries the fat and the broth, and a dry, plain bowl of rice under good chicken is a failed plate.

ingredients.name: ice water
ingredients.note: a large bowlful, for the plunge

ingredients.name: jasmine rice
ingredients.note: rinsed until the water runs clear, then drained

ingredients.name: chicken fat
ingredients.note: trimmed from the cavity of the bird

ingredient_groups.name: For the ginger and scallion oil

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.note: sliced as thinly as you can

steps.text: Rub the whole chicken inside and out with the salt, then rinse it clean. Pull the pads of chicken fat out of the cavity and set them aside.
steps.tip: That fat is the entire point of the rice. Do not bin it.

steps.text: Bring the water to a boil with the ginger and scallions, lower the bird in breast down, and immediately drop the heat until the surface stops moving.
Poach until the thickest part of the thigh is just done, turning the bird once halfway.
steps.tip: The water must never bubble. If it does, the breast tightens and no amount of resting brings it back.

steps.text: Lift the chicken out and plunge it into ice water until it is cold right through, then brush it all over with sesame oil.
steps.tip: The cold shock is what sets the slippery jelly layer under the skin that people queue for.

steps.text: Render the reserved chicken fat in a pan over low heat, then fry the garlic and shallots in it until pale gold.
Stir in the drained jasmine rice and toast it until every grain is coated and turning translucent at the edges.
Add the poaching broth, the pandan leaves and the salt, then cook the rice covered until the liquid is gone and the grains are separate.
steps.tip: Measure the broth rather than reusing your plain-rice ratio. The fat means it needs slightly less liquid than you expect.

steps.text: Put the ginger, scallions and salt in a heatproof bowl. Heat the peanut oil until it shimmers and pour it straight over.
steps.tip: It should sizzle hard for a couple of seconds. If it does not, the oil was too cool and the ginger stays raw and hot.

steps.text: Blend the red chillies, garlic, ginger, lime juice, sugar, salt and the poaching broth into a loose, pourable sauce.
Carve the chicken onto a plate at room temperature, serve the rice alongside, and put both sauces and a small bowl of the remaining broth on the table.
steps.tip: Room temperature, not fridge cold and not hot. Straight from the ice bath it tastes of nothing; reheated it may as well be a roast.
